blockchain.excerpt: The Entra ID flaw earned the highest possible severity score, but Microsoft says it patched the bug before publishing the CVE and found no evidence it was ever exploited.

blockchain.title: AI Has Made Bitcoin Software a Target—This Group Is Fighting Back

blockchain.title: Crypto advocates join in suing Illinois over digital asset tax
